properties.bedrock_type: Lower Carboniferous Sandstone and Siltstone (Gullane Formation / Edinburgh Calciferous Sandstone Group)
properties.mineralogy: Fine-to-medium grained quartz arenite with intercalated mudstones and doleritic volcanic sills
properties.drainage: Urbanized shallow till over bedrock with moderate subterranean percolation towards the Water of Leith basin

properties.primary_surfacing: Coarse-graded asphalt roadbed framed by whinstone and granite kerbing with Scottish sandstone slab and concrete modular pedestrian paving
properties.wear_characteristics: Bitumen seam patching, fine gravel aggregate wear along traffic channels, and iron drain grating seated in stone gullies
properties.micro_grading: Gentle southward gradient descending toward the Water of Leith valley

properties.groundcover: Domestic garden turf, moss patches (Rhytidiadelphus squarrosus), and perennial border plantings

properties.primary_building_typology: Late-Victorian / Edwardian Stockbridge Tenement and Terrace Enclave

structures.name: Dunrobin Place Tenement Flank
structures.roof_geometry: steeply pitched Scottish slate roof with dressed stone chimney stacks and ceramic chimney pots
structures.facade_material: coursed blond and grey Craigleith/Hailes carboniferous sandstone ashlar with lime mortar joints
structures.weathering_patina: pronounced historical coal-smoke soot staining and carbon crusting along window reveals, lintels, and overhanging eaves

structures.name: Adjoining Residential Terraced Block
structures.roof_geometry: dual-pitch Ballachulish slate roof with lead valley gutters and stone parapet upstands
